name: mixed-endian
title: Mixed-endian support: per-field and per-struct byte-order overrides
description: Allow selecting LSB/MSB (little/big-endian) representation on a per-field and per-structure basis. Endian inherited by default; explicit value overrides. Per-struct override inherits into nested sub-structs unless they override. Pointer fields always use global endian.
creator: deviousprophet
